import copy
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import ezdxf

root = Path.cwd()
out = root / "build/rpp5gx-evidence/next-offset"
tool = root / "tools/qualify_material_source_order.py"
adapter = root / "build/CMakeFiles/libdxfrw_root_test_adapter.dir/dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp.o"
library = root / "build/libdxfrw.a"
cli = root / "build/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf"
fixture = root / "build/libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests"
probe_source = out / "unused-offset-probe.cpp"
probe = out / "unused-offset-probe"
manifest = root / "build/rpp5gx-evidence/sources-final.sha256"


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def run(command):
    start = time.monotonic()
    process = subprocess.run(list(map(str, command)), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    return {"command": list(map(str, command)), "exitCode": process.returncode,
            "seconds": time.monotonic() - start, "stdout": process.stdout, "stderr": process.stderr}


def check_binding():
    for path, wanted in bindings.items():
        assert digest(root / path) == wanted, path
    for line in manifest.read_text().splitlines():
        wanted, path = line.split(None, 1)
        assert digest(root / path) == wanted, path


bindings = {str(path.relative_to(root)): digest(path)
            for path in (tool, adapter, library, cli, fixture, probe_source, manifest)}
check_binding()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("peer_qualifier", tool)
peer = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(peer)
assert ezdxf.__version__ == "1.4.5"

report = {"schema": "unused-mlinestyle-offset-readiness-v1", "date": "2026-10-28",
          "state": "BASELINE_IN_PROGRESS", "headCommit": subprocess.check_output(
              ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
          "candidate": "Fixed-shape offset49 transactions for an original MLINESTYLE with no emitted MLINE consumers",
          "fileSha256": bindings, "sourceInputs": len(manifest.read_text().splitlines()),
          "runtime": {"pythonExecutable": __import__("sys").executable,
                      "ezdxf": ezdxf.__version__,
                      "packages": {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in (
                          "ezdxf", "numpy", "fonttools", "pyparsing", "typing_extensions")}},
          "drawingsCommitted": False, "sourcePostMutation": False,
          "auditRecoveryOrOutputRepair": False, "adapterOrLibraryRebuilt": False,
          "fullSuiteRun": False, "supportLedgerPromoted": False}
build = run(["/usr/bin/clang++", "-std=c++17", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Werror",
             "-I" + str(root), "-I" + str(root / "src"), "-I" + str(root / "build"),
             probe_source, adapter, library, "-o", probe])
report["probeBuild"] = build
assert build["exitCode"] == 0, build
report["probeSha256"] = digest(probe)

doc, _, styles, consumers, null_bindings, omitted = peer.author_mline_style_authority_profile(
    ezdxf, retarget_style=True)
assert set(styles) == {"Standard", "PeerMline", "PeerRetarget"}
assert styles["PeerRetarget"]["elements"][0][0] == 1.25
assert len(consumers) == 2
linetypes = {entry.dxf.name: peer.simple_linetype_values(entry) for entry in (
    doc.linetypes.get("BYLAYER"), doc.linetypes.get("CONTINUOUS"))}
emitted_linetypes = copy.deepcopy(linetypes)
assert emitted_linetypes["Continuous"]["description"] == ""
emitted_linetypes["Continuous"]["description"] = "Solid line"
source = out / "original-unused-PeerRetarget-AC1027-asc.dxf"
doc.saveas(source, fmt="asc")
source_hash = digest(source)


def project(path, binary, expected, original=False):
    return peer.selected_mline_style_projection(
        ezdxf, path, binary, expected, source_recipe=original,
        consumer_expected=consumers, consumer_style_key="PeerMline",
        linetype_expected=linetypes if original else emitted_linetypes)


report["source"] = {"path": str(source), "sha256": source_hash,
                    "recipe": "Existing original-from-scratch typed authority recipe with PeerMline/PeerRetarget; target authored before geometry/first save; actual ENTITIES/BLOCKS consumers remain on PeerMline",
                    "expectedStyles": styles, "expectedConsumers": consumers,
                    "selectedUnusedStyle": "PeerRetarget", "originalOffset": 1.25,
                    "selectedNullLayerBindings": null_bindings,
                    "omittedDefaultMaterialHandles": omitted,
                    "observations": project(source, False, styles, True)}
cli_target = out / "cli-unchanged-asc.dxf"
unchanged = run([cli, source, "-y", "-v2013", cli_target])
assert unchanged["exitCode"] == 0, unchanged
unchanged.update({"path": str(cli_target), "sha256": digest(cli_target),
                  "observations": project(cli_target, False, styles)})
report["unchangedCli"] = unchanged

changed = copy.deepcopy(styles)
offset, color, linetype = changed["PeerRetarget"]["elements"][0]
assert offset == 1.25
changed["PeerRetarget"]["elements"][0] = (1.75, color, linetype)
report["controls"] = []
for mode, fmt in [("unchanged", "asc"), *((mode, fmt) for mode in ("typed", "raw") for fmt in ("asc", "bin"))]:
    target = out / ("probe-" + mode + "-" + fmt + ".dxf")
    row = run([probe, source, target, mode, fmt])
    assert row["exitCode"] == 0, row
    control = json.loads(row["stdout"])
    assert control["selectedCallerSnapshotPreserved"] == 1 and control["otherOriginalMlineConsumers"] == 2
    assert control["accepted"] == (mode != "typed")
    assert control["sentinelPreserved"] == (mode == "typed")
    row.update({"control": control, "path": str(target), "sha256": digest(target)})
    if mode != "typed":
        assert control["selectedDefinitionAuthorityAndOutputQualified"] == 1
        row["observations"] = project(target, fmt == "bin", changed if mode == "raw" else styles)
    else:
        assert target.read_bytes() == b"UNUSED_STYLE_OFFSET_ATOMIC_DESTINATION"
        row["destinationKind"] = "unchanged preexisting sentinel, not a DXF output"
    report["controls"].append(row)
    assert digest(source) == source_hash
    check_binding()

report.update({"state": "READY_LOCAL_UNUSED_DEFINITION_TRANSACTION_GAP_REPRODUCED",
               "result": {"independentOriginalProjection": True, "unchangedActualCliProjection": True,
                          "unchangedProbeOriginalTargetAndProvidersQualified": True,
                          "typedOffsetAtomicRefusals": 2, "rawOffsetExactExports": 2,
                          "selectedCallerPublicSnapshotsPreserved": 5,
                          "bothOtherOriginalConsumerGeometriesPreserved": True},
               "missingLayer": [
                   "prepareDxfMLineStyles typed/original mlineFieldsEqual still rejects element.offset differences; existing raw49 route already transports an unused target change.",
                   "Reconcile original/typed/raw offset49 by ordered tuple, reject competing changes and encode only final owning49 slots; keep fixed count and all other tuple mirrors strict.",
                   "Compute geometryChanged from the reconciled projection offsets versus original, not parsed raw offsets alone. Preserve refusal for every live consumer of a changed style until its geometry operation is qualified.",
                   "Prove all supported live consumer scopes/memberships before calling a style unused, and recheck late mutation/retargeting into that style. Reuse current source dictionary/body/provider and actual-output proof."],
               "requiredFutureTestsNotExecuted": [
                   "Typed/raw/agreeing/disjoint unused offset edits, conflicts, nonfinite values and fixed-count/CMC/mirror guards.",
                   "Owning49 slot scope plus output corruption, destination/caller preservation, sparse newly charged allocations and corrected retries.",
                   "Use the same genuine ENTITIES/BLOCKS recipe: offset edits to consumed PeerMline must remain refused, including typed-only and raw-only requests and late reference/geometry changes."],
               "caveats": [
                   "This is a narrow readiness baseline, not implementation or per-version/full-document/native qualification.",
                   "Source is AC1027 ASCII; target controls cover ASCII/binary. Only the selected first-offset request is exercised.",
                   "Caller snapshots cover selected public modeled/common/application/XDATA fields and raw carrier/context ownership, not every private parser field or all dx_data collections.",
                   "The independent ordinary reader can create defaults during document setup; physical checks precede it and added materials remain disclosed.",
                   "Known Continuous source empty-description to output Solid line projection is explicit; arbitrary names/provider fields are not normalized.",
                   "No consumed-geometry recalculation, cut/fill-gap preservation, count editing or native rendering claim is made."],
               "bindingsUnchangedAfterRun": True})
check_binding()
assert digest(source) == source_hash
report_path = out / "readiness.json"
report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"report": str(report_path), "sha256": digest(report_path),
                  "probeSha256": digest(probe), "sourceSha256": source_hash,
                  "result": report["result"]}, indent=2))
